title: Oily tender Australian rice Bowl
description: A comforting and flavorful Australian dish featuring roasted rice, lime, and mortar-pestle-pounded ingredients. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: In a small saucepan, toast the peanuts over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant.
In a large bowl, combine the rice, coconut oil, lime juice, ginger, cumin, and coriander powder.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the toasted peanuts until they form a fine paste.
Add the peanut paste to the rice mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a Korean brass bowl or a similar oven-safe dish.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the rice is tender and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
